name: Omamich
author: omamich contributors
description: Your Immich photo library in a native Omarchy window: a fast timeline, albums, people, places, search and a keyboard-first viewer. It also watches folders and uploads new photos and videos to Immich, Mimick-style, following your Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: Your Immich library. The icon shows when folder sync is working or needs attention; click it to open the window.

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar
schema.description: Turn this off to keep Omamich out of the bar. Folder sync keeps running; open the window with a keybinding: o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + I", "Omamich", "omarchy shell shell toggle dpetrariu.omamich '{}'")
